error[ZBX-E0601]: pasta is not installed
  cause  no executable named pasta in the directories of PATH
  fix    install pasta (Debian, Ubuntu):   sudo apt install passt
         or run with the host's network:   zbx run --net host alpine -- sh
  more   zbx explain E0601 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0601.html
